    total = 0
    digit_chars = filter(str.isdigit, s)
    values = map(int, digit_chars)
    for value in values:
        total += value
    return total

    value = celsius * 10
    rounded = round(value)
    sign = '-' if rounded < 0 else ''
    rounded = abs(rounded)
    whole, tenth = divmod(rounded, 10)
    return f"{sign}{whole}.{tenth}°C"

def minutes_to_time_str(minutes):
    total = minutes % 1440
    hours, mins = divmod(total, 60)
    h_str = str(hours) if hours >= 10 else '0' + str(hours)
    m_str = str(mins) if mins >= 10 else '0' + str(mins)
    return h_str + ':' + m_str
